## Before Next Class

### Readings for Class Week (and our Quiz)

1.  [**Dig Deeper Part 1 : Finding and Evaluating the Research Article.**](https://www.loom.com/share/fe95185d0a2a42bfb53f6b97bb0ed817)From the pop-psych article to the research article.

2.  [**Dig Deeper Part 2 : Evaluating the Measures and Methods**](https://www.loom.com/share/d7f0758e63ee419f8d9de8b2dd3446f2)**.** A professor guide to evaluating the measures and methods of your paper. Whew!

3.  [**Chapter 5 - Experiments.**](https://kpu.pressbooks.pub/psychmethods4e/chapter/experiment-basics/)A review of some of the basics of experimental design.

### Week 9 Discussion Questions.

1.  **WE DID THIS IN CLASS : Complete Part 1 (Finding the Research Article).** Make sure you are finding a specific empirical article - you might need to do some...digging...to find the right article (a study where the researchers studied a group of participants; not a review article or literature review.) Okay to have questions, but try to find something!
2.  **ON THE DIG DEEPER TAB : Complete Part 2 (Evaluating the Measures and Methods).** Okay if you have questions or are confused - just do your best. Highlight any questions / places where you are stuck in yellow to help flag them for me (and us!) I've posted an example to help get y'all started.
3.  **ON THE WEEK 10 TAB :** What's a question or something you want to learn more about regarding experiments?
